blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—Police arrested the pines city’s No. 4 most wanted person during an operation in Barangay Andres Bonifacio. In a report Thursday (Oct. 22), the Baguio City Police Office (BCPO) said the 46-year-old man was nabbed by the Tracker Team of Police Station 7. The apprehension was done by virtue of a warrant of arrest for alleged violations of Republic Act (RA) 7610, or the Special Protection of Children Against Abuse, Exploitation and Discrimination Act, and Republic Act 11313, or the Safe Spaces Act.
